title: DDS: Fix loading 3D textures with mipmaps

target.summary: `r_dds_type & DDST_3D` treats `r_dds_type` as a bitmask rather than checking `(r_dds_type & DDST_TYPE_MASK) == DDST_3D`. Consequently, non-3D textures (such as 2D textures) sharing that bit are mistakenly loaded as 3D textures, breaking their mipmaps.
notes: faulty statement passing `r_dds_type & DDST_3D` instead of checking `(r_dds_type & DDST_TYPE_MASK) == DDST_3D`
